# ADTT Projects Pte Ltd

> Singapore signboard contractor and commercial space transformation specialist. We supply and install signage & printing, PDLC smart film (switchable privacy glass), architectural interior film, and ACP façade cleaning for retail, office, medical, F&B, hospitality, education and residential clients island-wide in Singapore.

ADTT Projects Pte Ltd is a registered Singapore company (UEN verified) with 10+ years of experience and 500+ completed projects. All signage is fabricated in-house; all installation is done by our own professional team — no middleman markup. Free site survey is available island-wide with no obligation.

## Services

- Signage & Printing: LED signboards, acrylic signage, 3D lettering, lightbox signs, shopfront signage, office signage & wayfinding, vehicle wraps, event displays.
- Smart Film (PDLC): Switchable privacy film for glass partitions — offices, meeting rooms, clinics, hospitals, and residential windows. Instantly toggles between clear and frosted.
- Interior Film: Wood grain, marble, metallic and decorative film for walls, furniture, cabinets and lift interiors — a renovation alternative without demolition or downtime.
- ACP Façade Cleaning: Professional cleaning and restoration of aluminium composite panel building facades, including rope access and gondola-capable teams for high-rise buildings.

## Coverage

Island-wide across Singapore, including CBD, Orchard Road, Jurong, Tampines, Woodlands, Punggol, Clementi, Toa Payoh, Ang Mo Kio, Bedok, Buona Vista, Alexandra, Queenstown, Bishan, Serangoon, Novena, Bugis, Kallang and Paya Lebar. No travel surcharge for site surveys.
